subject: On-site visit: compact walkthrough vs alternate windows
content:
Message 1
From: Sam Torres <s.torres@blueharbor.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0500
Subject: On-site week of Nov 16 — planning and agenda

Hi Naomi,

Hope you're well. We're planning a week of site visits for our operations team (Nov 16-19) and we'd love to anchor a Redwood walkthrough while the group is on campus. Primary goals: a 90–120 minute product walkthrough (high-level + operational Q&A) and a 60-minute technical break-out with our infra leads.

Current constraints: Anna (anna.liu@blueharbor.com) will be traveling with the field team for the first half of the week and is back on Nov 17 afternoon, but we may have late changes to travel windows. Would you be able to propose a compact session that fits into a half-day on Nov 17 or 18, or offer an alternative if Anna's availability shifts?

Attached is a quick internal agenda draft.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Sam
Director of Operations
Blue Harbor Logistics

[Attachment: blueharbor-prospect-agenda.docx (12KB)]

-----

Message 2
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <s.torres@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-site week of Nov 16 — planning and agenda

Hi Sam — thanks for the agenda and context.

We can absolutely accommodate a compact, production-focused walkthrough. Quick options to keep on the table:
- Option A: 90-minute compact on Nov 17 (10:00–11:30) — high-level + 30-min technical breakout.
- Option B: 120-minute slot on Nov 18 morning (09:00–11:00) for a fuller demo and extended Q&A.
- Option C: Recorded 45-minute walkthrough + 60-minute live Q&A on whichever afternoon Anna is available (this reduces scheduling friction).

If Anna's travel ends up shifting, Option C gives you flexibility. Looping in Aditya (AE) and Connor (SE) to prep the compact deck and the technical appendix.

Proposed next step: can you confirm the preferred option and an attendee window (time zone/local site)? I attached a short Redwood quickdeck and a condensed agenda for Option A.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

[Attachment: redwood-quickdeck.pdf (1.2MB)]

-----

Message 3 (internal)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: prep for Blue Harbor — compact option A

Team — quick internal notes while we wait on Sam's confirmation:
- Aditya: can you prep pricing/comparison slide that shows cost per 1M tokens for a steady-state deployment vs burst? Keep to one slide.
- Connor: please extract KV cache performance numbers and 95th pct latency for sequences <=512 tokens — the ops lead is likely to ask.
- We may need a one-page install checklist if they ask about on-prem connectivity. I attached a compact agenda draft (compact-agenda-v2).

Keep it light — they prefer short and practical.

Thanks,
Naomi

[Attachment: compact-agenda-v2.docx (24KB)]

-----

Message 4
From: Sam Torres <s.torres@blueharbor.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: On-site week of Nov 16 — planning and agenda

Hi Naomi — thanks for the quick reply. Heads up: Anna's travel window just changed. She is out with the field crew until late on Nov 17 and won't be available in the morning. Our operations VP also has a standing pull for the morning on Nov 18.

New preference: can we target Nov 19 between 14:00–16:00 local (on-site) for the compact walkthrough? If that's not viable for Redwood, we'd accept Option C (recorded walkthrough + a 60-min live Q&A when Anna is available) — Anna will be available the afternoon of Nov 19 but only starting 14:00.

Apologies for the churn — field logistics are messy. Please confirm what you can do and whether you need an attendee list from our side.

Sam

-----

Message 5
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <s.torres@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-site week of Nov 16 — planning and agenda

Sam — all good, and thanks for the heads up. Nov 19 14:00–15:30 works for us as a compact in-person window. We'll plan the session as: 45-minute product walkthrough (ops focus), 30-minute technical breakout, 15-minute open Q&A. If you expect additional stakeholders, please send an attendee list (names + roles) and we can tailor the breakout.

If anything shifts last minute, we'll fall back to Option C (I will send a short recorded walkthrough + schedule a 60-minute Q&A several days later).

I've attached the updated compact agenda and added a tentative calendar invite to the slot. HubSpot deal updated with the new date — see link below.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments:
- compact-agenda-v2.docx (updated)
- calendar-invite.ics
